text: Git branching helps teams work on code without affecting the main project. A feature branch lets a developer build something new, like a login page, in a safe space. When the work is finished, they merge the branch back into the main code. Before merging, teams often use pull requests so others can review the changes and suggest improvements. This creates a clear version control workflow: create a branch, make changes, open a pull request, review, and merge. It keeps the main branch stable and makes teamwork much easier.
